description: Page through a batch's results by its taskId (cursor, limit up to 50). fields keeps only the named item fields (plus id, url, status, createdAt), e.g. ["json"] for a JSON batch. With maxResults the tool follows the cursors itself and answers { items, nextCursor, hasMore, stoppedBy }.

maxResults.description: Follow the cursors and return up to this many items in all.

name: get_batch_items

stoppedBy.description: size: the answer reached its size budget; read on from nextCursor.

title: Get batch items
